description.text: Revised prescribing information to include second-year data from YOSEMITE and RHINE studies in patients with diabetic macular edema

citations.quote: Please refer to your supplemental biologics license application (sBLA), dated and received March 29, 2022, and your amendments, submitted under section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act for Vabysmo (farcimab-svoa) injection, for intravitreal use. This supplemental biologics license application provides for a revision to the prescribing information to include the second year data from studies YOSEMITE and RHINE conducted in patients with diabetic macular edema.

description.text: Added indication for treatment of macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO)

citations.quote: Please refer to your supplemental biologics license application (sBLA) dated and received February 22, 2023, and your amendments, submitted under section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act for Vabysmo (faricimab-sv0a) injection, for intravitreal use. This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for the treatment of macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO).

description.text: Removed the 6-month duration specified for monthly dosing for treatment of macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sBLA provides for revisions to the DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION section of the Prescribing Information to remove the 6-month duration specified for monthly dosing for the treatment of macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO).
